products.title: Leveling Up The Closed Guard by Sathya Bird Wiltse
products.body:
Transform your closed guard into a relentless offensive weapon. In Leveling Up The Closed Guard, world-class competitor Sathya “Bird” Wiltse breaks down his aggressive, pressure-based approach to one of jiu-jitsu’s most classic positions—bringing new life to an old-school staple.

  • This instructional isn’t about stalling or holding on. It’s about attacking with purpose, sweeping with precision, and forcing reactions that lead to fight-ending submissions
  • Bird Wiltse shares the same closed guard system that’s helped him succeed at the highest levels of competition, combining modern details with old-school grit to give you a closed guard that’s as dangerous as it is frustrating for your opponents.
  • Whether you're a white belt looking to build a foundation or a seasoned competitor wanting to sharpen your edge, Leveling Up The Closed Guard gives you the tools to control, attack, and finish from one of the most underestimated positions in jiu-jitsu.

This instructional isn’t about stalling or holding on. It’s about attacking with purpose, sweeping with precision, and forcing reactions that lead to fight-ending submissions. Bird Wiltse shares the same closed guard system that’s helped him succeed at the highest levels of competition, combining modern details with old-school grit to give you a closed guard that’s as dangerous as it is frustrating for your opponents.

✅ What You’ll Learn Inside:

  • Bird’s Signature Closed Guard Entries – Learn how to pull and establish closed guard with control and intent

  • Relentless Attack Chains – Transition seamlessly between submissions like armbar, triangle, omoplata, and more

  • Sweep With Strategy – Off-balance and reverse your opponents with high-percentage sweeps built off real reactions

  • Breaking Posture the Smart Way – Apply pressure to force predictable movements and capitalize instantly

  • Maintaining & Recovering Guard – Stay locked in and dangerous even against explosive passers

  • High-Level Concepts from a World-Class Competitor – Understand timing, angle, and pressure from someone who lives it on the mats

Whether you're a white belt looking to build a foundation or a seasoned competitor wanting to sharpen your edge, Leveling Up The Closed Guard gives you the tools to control, attack, and finish from one of the most underestimated positions in jiu-jitsu.

products.title: The Falcon Guard By Joel Bouhey
products.body:
This Simple Tweak Turns A Regular Closed Guard Into A Closed Guard On Steroids

  • Luis Heredia Black Belt Joel Bouhey’s Falcon Guard Opens Up A Ton Of Easy Sweeps & Submissions
  • The closed guard is a forgotten art
  • This system will be effective both in sport and self-defense
  • Develop a next to impossible to deal with closed guard
  • Use this in both gi and no gi

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Luis Heredia Black Belt Joel Bouhey’s Falcon Guard Opens Up A Ton Of Easy Sweeps & Submissions They Will Never See Coming!



The Closed Guard has become a stalling position. Guys get there, and the fight stops.. It becomes ugly.. boring. Joel Bouhey, a very well respected black belt from Hawaii has come up with a very nice tweak for this position. By overhooking one arm and connecting it to his other arm, he develops superior leverage that is very hard to manage. This creates the venerable Falcon Guard!

 

Once he gets this grip he has a huge advantage. Joel originally developed this position for MMA – he completely envelops the person he is going against from his own back. The guy on top is helpless to defend. If you are looking to give yourself the upperhand from the guard, level it up with the Falcon Guard variation with BJJ Black Belt Joel Bouhey!

products.title: Closed Guard Should Be Illegal by Sula Loewenthal
products.body:
Closed Guard Should Be Illegal by Sula Loewenthal

  • Learn from Sula Loewenthal, a seasoned BJJ black belt with years of competition and teaching experience.
  • Master essential closed guard techniques including the Waiter Sweep, Omoplata, and Triangle to elevate your game.
  • Designed for practitioners of all levels, from beginners looking to solidify their fundamentals to advanced students seeking to refine their skills.
  • Unlock the secrets of effective hand fighting and grip stripping to dominate your opponents from the closed guard position.


What Will You Learn?

In 'Closed Guard Should Be Illegal,' Sula Loewenthal delivers a comprehensive instructional that empowers you to take control of the closed guard position. Across three action-packed volumes, you'll learn a variety of techniques that will enhance your grappling arsenal, including sweeps, submissions, and back takes. Whether you're a novice or an experienced practitioner, this series is tailored to help you develop a strategic approach to closed guard, ensuring you can effectively counter your opponent's moves and capitalize on every opportunity.
